chatBody: Ask a question about this corpus. The answer cites the chunks it read.
chatSendHint: Enter sends. Shift plus Enter adds a line.
chatHistoryEmpty: No saved sessions yet. Your first chat creates one.
chatDisabledBody: Chat ships switched off. The owner turns it on in config.yaml.

chatStatusEnabled: Chat is on. The rung is {backend}.
chatErrorTurn: This turn failed. Send it again.
